question: What sum will earn a simple interest of Rs. 960 in 3 years at 16% per year rate of interest?
solution:
**Given:**

Simple Interest (SI) = Rs. 960

Time (T) = 3 years

Rate of Interest (R) = 16% per year

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (Principal (P) × Rate (R) × Time (T)) / 100
